name: Jonathan Gannon

views.text: Stay where your feet are; this week is the only one you can win.
The best disguise makes two looks identical, so the quarterback has to guess.
A quarterback who can make every throw and protect the ball is the hardest thing to defend.
Hire coaches for how they think and whether they serve players, not for their age.
Loving football means you never have to look for motivation.
When a coach loses his composure, he owns it in front of the team, apologizes and moves on.
Labels like 4-3 or 3-4 matter less than putting players where they feel sure of themselves.
Failing as a head coach teaches things no coordinator job can, and a good coach carries that back to the field.

signatures: leans on a stock of short catchphrases that reporters start collecting
apologizes to the team as a group when he crosses a line
talks about the fun of being back to hands-on coaching after running a whole team

motivation.want: to rebuild his name with a top defense and earn another head coaching chance
motivation.fear: that his losing seasons as a head coach define him more than his defenses

voice: High-energy and emphatic, full of slogans and punchy phrases. He is candid and good-humored about his setbacks, grateful rather than bitter about Arizona, and effusive about players he likes. When he gets something wrong he names it plainly and apologizes.

evidence.summary: Introduced four days after his Eagles lost the Super Bowl, he stresses staying in the present, praises Murray as a rare problem for defenses, and says he never needs to look for motivation because he loves football. Writer contrasts his energy with the reserved previous coach.

A light guide to seven recurring phrases from his introduction about accountability, team-first play, bold action and focus; Bidwill says he used one favorite word in about a dozen ways in his interview. Shows a speaking habit, not substance.

He hires Petzing, 35, who worked with him in Minnesota, and Rallis, 29, his Eagles linebackers coach and a Vikings colleague, saying age was never a factor and he judged candidates on thinking and character. Team site.

Explains Murray taking more snaps under center in 2023; Gannon says the aim was to create conflict so defenses cannot tell run from pass, and Petzing stresses that every look must appear identical. Scheme detail with quotes.

The team fines him $100,000 after video shows him shouting at and swiping toward running back Demercado following a costly fumble; he says he apologized to the player and team, let the moment overwhelm him, and calls it a mistake. One incident; the league took no action.

Green Bay names him defensive coordinator to replace Jeff Hafley after Arizona fired him following a 3-14 season and a 15-36 record over three years; he ran the Eagles' defense on their Super Bowl LVII run and plans to fit his scheme to the players' strengths. Wire report.

First Green Bay media session: front labels matter less than putting players where they feel confident; praises Jordan Love as a top-tier quarterback; glad to reconnect with LaFleur; jokes about sweating through his interview in a coat and tie and says he told his wife Green Bay was the place. Candid and good-humored.

evidence.publisher: Sports Illustrated (Cardinals on SI), Donnie Druin
evidence.summary: On his Arizona tenure he is grateful, calls the head job a real education he will carry into Green Bay, says the Packers will run a new system rather than his Arizona defense, and enjoys returning to hands-on coaching.
